Morgan (People Ops): Quick heads up — Jamie from Eng submitted an early resignation today. Last day set as 2026-04-10. Need COBRA date, final pay/payout clarity, and a laptop return plan.
Liz Chen: Thanks for the flag. Do we have manager confirmation on the date? @Paul Rivera can you confirm? :eyes:
Paul Rivera: Confirmed with manager. KT week planned 2026-04-03 to 04-07. Exit interview ok on 2026-04-09 11:00am.
Morgan (People Ops): Scheduling exit interview for 4/9 11am. @HR Bot please queue exit survey and COBRA paperwork to jamie@example.com.
HR Bot: Automated: Exit survey sent to jamie@example.com. COBRA notes: coverage end date typically = last day of employment month + coverage through that month (employee must elect within 60 days). COBRA packet will be mailed within 14 days after termination processed. More: https://benefits.example.com/cobra
Liz Chen: Payroll question — payroll cutoff is 2026-04-05; with a 4/10 last day, will final pay include accrued PTO payout or does that need manager sign-off? @Finance?
Paul Rivera: Manager already approved accrued PTO payout per policy; will confirm amount to payroll.
IT Oncall: For IT: Jamie prefers dropbox return at HQ for the company laptop. I'll open ticket IT-5842 for pickup logistics and a return label if remote.
Morgan (People Ops): We also need to schedule SSO/service deprovisioning. Plan is to revoke SSO/API tokens the morning after last day unless there's a business need to extend. @IT Oncall can you coordinate exact timing?
IT Oncall: Will revoke access at 09:00 UTC on 2026-04-11 after HR confirms termination completed. Will snapshot home dir and hand ownership to manager. Commands I plan to run:
```
sudo rsync -a /home/jamie /home/jamie_offboard_snapshot
sudo chown -R paul.rivera:eng-team /home/jamie_offboard_snapshot
```
And I'll archive any relevant SSH keys to IT vault.
Paul Rivera: I'll produce a KT doc and checklist in Confluence and tag owners. Draft will be at https://confluence.example.com/display/ENG/Offboards (adding Jamie page).
Liz Chen: One more — Jamie mentioned possible 1099 consulting after leaving. Is there a standard process to evaluate post-employment consulting so we don't run into conflicts?
Morgan (People Ops): Good catch. Marking 'consider contractor conversion' in the offboard tracker; legal will review NDAs/conflict terms. Manager to loop in Legal.
HR Bot: Reminder: Employee has 60 days to elect COBRA and 30 days to return signed enrollment to maintain uninterrupted benefits.
Morgan (People Ops): I'll update the offboard tracker with COBRA dates, pickup ticket, and revoked-access schedule. Anything else?
Liz Chen: Please confirm equipment return label and that PMs have viewing access to KT docs. :+1:
Paul Rivera: Thanks everyone. Jamie — if you see this, DM me and we'll book the KT slots.
